next.reason: §2023:13.18.60.4 GR10 repeats the 1985 rule: index data item whose value 'shall correspond to an occurrence number of a table element', with alignment, representation and the value for each occurrence number specified by the implementor (documented per DOC-A.1-211). The added 'The class and category of an index data item are index' names the item and changes no 1985 program.
